'''Karel Novy''' (born 12 June 1980 as Karel Nový) is a Swiss freestyle swimmer who won three bronze medals at short-course (25 m pool) European Championships.<ref name=r1/> He also competed in five freestyle events at the Summer Olympics of 2000, 2004 and 2008, but never reached the finals.<ref name=r2/>
